title: Google, Bing, OpenAI, Anthropic support unified robots.txt opt-out for AI training
content:
X author: @sengineland

Search Engine Land reported that Google, Bing, OpenAI, and Anthropic now support a single robots.txt directive for opting out of AI training, with Google implementing in 2027; a separate control remains for AI Overviews. This standardizes publisher controls over crawler access for training data.

Linked sources:
- https://searchengineland.com/google-also-gives-publishers-more-control-over-how-ai-uses-their-content-499971
